rule_time_or_spread:
def rule(t, A):
    ts = t['t_in']
    ny = ts - (4 if 1772953200 <= ts < 1793512800 else 5) * 3600
    wd = (math.floor(ny / 86400) + 3) % 7
    m = ny % 86400 / 60.0
    if 960.0 <= m < 1080.0 or (wd == 4 and 780.0 <= m < 1020.0):
        return True
    return t['side'] > 0 and t['fill'] - t['brk_hi_so_far'] >= 0.00015

rule_thin_hour:
def rule(t, A):
    k = t['k']
    v = A.v
    a = float(np.mean(v[max(k - 59, 0):k + 1]))
    b = float(np.mean(v[max(k - 599, 0):k + 1]))
    return b > 0 and a / b < 0.4

rule_fresh_flip_after_opp:
def rule(t, A):
    s = t['side']
    if abs(t['camStk']) != 1:
        return False
    H = A.humps
    H = H[H[:, 7] <= t['k']]
    tr = H[:, 6][::-1]
    i = 0
    while i < len(tr) and tr[i] == s:
        i += 1
    j = i
    while j < len(tr) and tr[j] == -s:
        j += 1
    return j - i >= 3
rule_trend_against_120:
def rule(t, A):
    k, s = (t['k'], t['side'])
    a = A.atr[k]
    return a > 0 and (A.c[k] - A.c[max(k - 120, 0)]) * s <= -12 * a
rule_extended_at_extreme:
def rule(t, A):
    k, s, f = (t['k'], t['side'], t['fill'])
    hi = float(np.max(A.h[max(k - 59, 0):k + 1]))
    lo = float(np.min(A.l[max(k - 59, 0):k + 1]))
    if s > 0:
        return f - lo >= 0.002 and hi - f <= 0.0001
    return hi - f >= 0.002 and f - lo <= 0.0001
